metadata.note: 1984 European, without catalyst. Four 3-into-1 manifolds (cylinders 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12) with equal primaries (equal length from an owners' forum; 0.50 m and 35.5 mm are estimates). Each bank's two manifold pipes (47 mm, from the 51 mm sealing rings; their lengths are estimates) enter its central silencer; a 57 mm pipe (the 61 mm sealing ring; 0.30 m an estimate) joins it to its side silencer; the banks do not meet. The parts catalogue lists an upper and a lower central silencer and a right and a left side silencer; no dimension of a silencer was found. Silencers are written as wide pipes: their lengths are estimates and their widths were set by ear (K, 2026-11-21). A side's two tailpipes (52 mm, an estimate) are written as one of their combined area. Valve: two exhaust valves of 28 mm and 9.5 mm lift (estimates); about 280 deg seat to seat, from 54 BBDC / 10 ATDC at 0.5 mm (shop manual via owners' forum).
